section_body: Guide selection is not a finishing decision. Frame geometry, ring size, spacing and wrap construction influence line flow, load transfer and finished weight.
section_tagline:
The path of the braid. The path of the load.
One system.
section_image_alt: Enlarged KAIZURO guide train and ring progression aligned along the blank

chapters.title: Strength without careless mass.
chapters.text: Heavy offshore guides must withstand impact, repeated loading and lateral force. The objective is sufficient frame strength and bracing without unnecessary weight in the working section.
chapters.mobile_text: Heavy offshore guides must withstand impact, repeated loading and lateral force without unnecessary weight in the working section.
chapters.image_alt: Close-up of KAIZURO guide frame and wrap detail

chapters.title: Secure where it matters. Controlled everywhere else.
chapters.text: Guide security depends on wrap length, thread build, resin control and preparation beneath the foot. Low-build construction manages avoidable weight and stiffness around the guide location.
chapters.mobile_text: Wrap length, thread build, resin control and preparation beneath the foot manage security, stiffness and avoidable mass.
chapters.image_alt: KAIZURO branded carbon blank and lower guide on a black studio background

chapters.title: From line coil to controlled path.
chapters.text: A large offshore spinning reel releases broad coils of braid. Guide size and progression gradually control that movement while maintaining clearance and supporting the blank under load.
chapters.mobile_text: Guide size and progression gradually control broad coils of braid while supporting the blank under load.
chapters.image_alt: KAIZURO rod working section with two heavy-duty guides

chapters.title: Power carried through the working section.
chapters.text: The main working section balances blank authority, guide support and controlled load transfer. It is where casting recovery becomes sustained pressure when the fight moves under load.
chapters.mobile_text: The main working section balances blank authority, guide support and controlled load transfer when the rod is under sustained pressure.
